own_study_claims.claim: Unresolved diagnostic adjudication and annotation blinding justify prioritizing independent diagnoses and documented annotation procedures
Derived images with unknown spatial scales justify checking metadata and specifying processing before future evaluation
Availability sampling and conditional internal uncertainty require evaluation beyond current dataset
Low fixed-threshold treatment-change recognition, descriptive calibration and unevaluated clinical utility motivate complementary assessment
Clinical and Fusion pipelines and their original input panel are locked and saved; no new model is selected in this section

interpretations: Recommendations are future work, not further validation already completed
Independent evaluation should carry forward locked pipelines; model updating would require separately reported evaluation
Sample-size planning is prospective and tailored to precision; no recruitment number, retrospective power or generic event-count adequacy claim supplied
Recognition and calibration supplement discrimination and probability error, rather than being replaced by AUC
Clinical-utility study would need a defined action and justified thresholds; no treatment advice or threshold recommended
